_comment: Studio1 paper style. Sources: brand/AI-SYSTEM-PROMPT.md, brand/README.md, public/brand/design-system/tokens/tokens.json and DESIGN.md in the website repo. Validated by src/design_agent/brand/schema.py; read by workspace/tools/brand-lint.mjs.

extendedPalette._note: The print ramp (steps 50, 200, 300, 400, 600, 800; 500 and 700 are core): charts, shading in illustrations and the swatch strip only. Never a new accent, a ground or a headline.

officialAssetColors._note: Colors that exist only inside official artwork. The sunrise panel is the blog-cover print panel from app/blog-cover/cover.tsx. #0a0a0a is the black of the wordmark and the black mark. The lint reads the color list as one global set and ignores the assets map, so these hexes pass in every file: use them only through sunrise-panel.css and the logo files.

bannedColors._note: The sources ban hues, not hexes: never blue, purple, teal, green, neon, rainbow, or a gradient background other than the sunrise panel. Any hex outside the palette already fails the lint as off-palette.

contrastExceptions.reason: Layer tag: white label on the orange tag, design-file markup
Headline keyword accent at 40px and up

diagramConstruction._note: 4 px spacing grid (DESIGN.md), 1 px hairline strokes (the border width token). The sources give no connector spec: these are the grid and hairline values, not a stated connector rule.

light._note: On paper. Muted is the solid warm neutral 700 (6.2:1); orange is a shape, never text, here.

dark._note: On Night. Print orange is 6.9:1 here, so it may be text.

rules: Paper first: at least 60% of every canvas is empty paper (#f4efe7). About 80% paper, 15% ink, 5% orange.
One accent: print orange (#f97316) on one or two things per piece. Block prints and the sunrise panel are the exceptions.
Print orange is 2.5:1 on paper. On paper it is a shape or display type of 40px and up, never body text or small labels. Small orange text on paper uses #c2410c. On Night it can be text (6.9:1).
Ink (#141414) text on orange fills (6.6:1). Paper or white on orange only for the logo, frame labels and display type.
Secondary text is ink at 70% or 60%, separators ink at 32%, hairlines ink at 14%, grid ink at 5%. On Night use paper at 70%, 60% and 14%. No new greys.
Studio1 Sans only, Regular 400 and Medium 500. No bold, no italics, no second font. Tracking -0.03em, headlines -0.045em at line height 1.1. Code uses the system monospace and nothing else does.
Orange text only at 40px and up on paper; smaller orange text uses #c2410c.

Corners: 0 on selection frames, block prints, images, stat cards, tags and labels. 6px on content tiles, inputs and code blocks, 4px on inline code. Buttons, avatars and status dots are fully round (999px). Nothing else.
Grain is a texture, not a colour: grain.svg multiplied over paper at 30%, over orange at 40%.
Gradients: only the sunrise panel on covers and share cards (sunrise-panel.css). Never a flat orange cover, never a gradient background elsewhere. The logo carries no gradient.
Spacing on a 4px grid: 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 96. Margins 52px on 1500x500, 60px on social posts, 80px on slides.
Real logo files only, never redrawn. Real people and real product UI only, no invented clients, dashboards or numbers.

copy._note: Applies to words on graphics and in posts the agent drafts. Only rules the Studio1 brand kit states.
rules: Plain, specific, short sentences, the way an engineer explains something to another engineer. Numbers and names over adjectives.
We is Studio1, you is the reader.
No emoji, no exclamation marks, no em dashes and no en dashes. Use a comma, a full stop or the word to.
Headlines and buttons in Title Case, centred; body copy and captions in sentence case; uppercase only for small eyebrow labels (12px, tracking 0.1em).
Stats are written 35+, 3M+ with the plus in orange.
Sublines split items with a middle dot at ink 32%: Content · Docs · Video. The middle dot is the house separator.
The name is Studio1: one word, capital S, the digit 1. Handle @Studio1HQ, site studio1hq.com.
DevTools is capitalised only as a headline accent; in sentences it is devtool or devtools. open source is the noun, open-source the adjective.
Colour one or two headline keywords orange, never a whole line.
